nodes.label: Concept: Extension Layers & Boundary Model (Core/System/Official Optional/SaaS Control Plane/ERP Extension/Derived App)
nodes.rationale: Defines six layers with dependency arrows always toward Core, and distinguishes tenant (security boundary) from legal entity/organization unit (business boundaries) to guide where new cross-repo capabilities belong.

nodes.label: Concept: Capability Ports (ADR-0011)
nodes.rationale: Pure TypeScript interfaces in _shared/ports that decouple a capability from its owning module's implementation, enabling cross-module/cross-repo collaboration without direct imports or shared-table writes.

nodes.label: Concept: No Shared-Table Write Rule
nodes.rationale: Only the owning module's code may write to its own tables; other modules must collaborate via capability ports/API/events, never a shared table, to preserve module boundaries under ADR-0013.
